assay_targets_or_enrichments.ontology_label: Affinity purification coupled with mass spectrometry proteomics

acquisition: The 12 most intense molecular ions in each MS scan were sequentially selected for high-energy collisional dissociation (HCD)
Dynamic exclusion (15 s) was enabled during the MS/MS data acquisition
labeling: Elmo1+/+ and Elmo1−/− osteoclasts were labeled with EZ-LinkTM NHS-Biotin (Thermo Fisher)
enrichment: ELMO1 was immunoprecipitated using the mouse anti-ELMO1 antibody

Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment uses a combination of immunoprecipitation (AP-MS) and biotin-labeling for surface protein enrichment. While biotin is used as a label, it is for enrichment/capture rather than a multiplexed quantification strategy like TMT, thus 'Other' is used for labeling and 'base_dda_lfq' is the most appropriate base for spectrum counting/LFQ-style analysis.

scope: ELMO1 was immunoprecipitated using the mouse anti-ELMO1 antibody made in-house (clone #7G9-A10-A3-D7) and Protein A agarose beads (Amersham), and immune complexes were washed and split into two parts.
Biotinilated proteins in the remaining immunoprecipitate were enriched by pulldown with NeutrAvidinTM agarose (Pierce, following manufacturer’s instructions) and subjected to SDS-PAGE.
